comp-mroo4m0o6.html:
We are looking for a technically strong and people-focused Team Leader to lead a small engineering team working on machine vision and industrial automation projects for leading international customers mainly in the tire and automotive industry.
 

You will lead a team of six engineers based in Prague. Alongside people leadership, you will be directly accountable for successful delivery of projects to our customers.
 

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys combining technology, people leadership, and project execution.

 

 

Your Role and Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Vision Systems engineering team.

  • Drive the successful delivery of industrial automation and machine vision projects.

  • Coordinate external mechanical and electrical engineering partners.

  • Define technical direction and development priorities.

  • Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure successful project execution.

  • Oversee project planning, budgets, quality, risks and timelines.

  • Support business development with technical expertise during pre-sales activities.

  • Improve engineering processes and delivery efficiency.

 

Position Requirements

  • Several years of experience leading technical or engineering teams.

  • Solid background in industrial automation, machine vision, robotics or manufacturing technologies.

  • Experience managing complex technical projects from concept to delivery.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with customers, suppliers and cross-functional teams.

  • Proven leadership and decision-making skills.

  • Strong ownership, initiative, prioritization, and time management.

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities.

  • Professional English - daily use.

  • Comfortable reviewing 3D CAD models and machine layouts, and discussing machine integration with external mechanical engineering partners.  

  • Our team primarily works with C#/.NET, HALCON and modern software development tools. Experience with similar technologies is an advantage.  

 

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to shape the future of our Vision Systems division.

  • Challenging international projects for leading industrial customers.

  • Flexible working hours and 1 day of home office per week.

  • Five weeks of vacation.

  • Three additional personal/sick days.

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.

  • Regular team events.
    ​

​

If you want to work on projects where business, technology, and data meet, send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

​

For more information contact:
Martina Hašková
+420 737 240 516
martina.haskova@datavision.cz
